stages.headline: Polygons are similar if their angles are equal in pairs and corresponding sides are proportional.
stages.headlineEnglish: Polygons are similar if their angles are equal in pairs and corresponding sides are proportional.

stages.headline: Any two squares, any two equilateral triangles and any two circles are similar.
stages.headlineEnglish: Any two squares, any two equilateral triangles and any two circles are similar.

stages.headline: But not all rectangles or rhombi are similar: 1 × 2 and 1 × 3 rectangles are not.
